item.text: Use **at least 1,000 ResStock samples** when no analysis-specific guidance is available. The team’s [ResStock FAQ](https://natlabrockies.github.io/ResStock.github.io/docs/FAQ.html) gives this as a conservative reference, associated with **15% or lower sampling discrepancy for many common quantities of interest**. For a specific analysis, they recommend estimating standard error to determine the appropriate minimum sample size.
